title: Cops seize nearly P2M in illegal drugs, arrests 14 in Western Visayas

blocks.text: ILOILO CITY, Philippines — Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) logged significant gains in its anti-criminality campaign, seizing nearly P2 million worth of illegal drugs, arresting 14 individuals, and securing 17 firearms across Western Visayas in a 24-hour period. According to the official report spanning 6 a.m. on Oct. 23 to 5:59 a.m. on Oct. 24, regional authorities conducted six anti-illegal drug operations. The operations yielded 292 grams of suspected shabu or meth and 8.93 grams of marijuana, carrying an estimated total value of P1,986,671.60.
